## Deterministic Model Contract

One complete set of user inputs and fixed parameters produces one result. The
model does not optimize, search a design space or select a preferred case.
Sensitivities and alternative designs are separate user-supplied cases.

## Controlled Taxonomy

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| User input | Value or discrete choice supplied for one model case |
| Fixed parameter | Sourced value or explicit modelling assumption held fixed for that case |
| Derived quantity | Calculated from inputs and parameters |
| Output | Reported physical, energy, cost or feasibility result |

A value must belong to exactly one class in a given calculation. A derived
quantity must not also be supplied as an independent input.

## Master User-Input Contract

| Field | Unit/type | Applicability | Owner | Required check | Current status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Architecture, $a$ | category | All | Architectures | Electricity, centralised hydrogen or decentralised hydrogen | Defined |
| Wind-resource record | dataset/version | All | WIND-002 | Source, period, location and direction convention supplied | Source record unresolved |
| Site/layout definition | coordinates or declared layout inputs | All | WIND-003 | One unambiguous layout route; no conflicting turbine-count and spacing definitions | Method unresolved |
| Turbine record | model/class | All | TURB-002 | Rated power, rotor, hub height and equipment boundary supplied | Partially defined |
| Water depth | m | All | TURB-003 and platform owners | Within adopted foundation/platform method range | Scenario input; range unresolved |
| Onshore endpoint and route records | route data | All | ELEC-004/005 or H2I-004 | Route segments and endpoint match selected carrier | Partially defined |
| Hydrogen stack overplant factor | dimensionless | Hydrogen | H2P-003 | Positive and consistent with module count | User input; range unresolved |
| Hydrogen operating pressure | bar | Hydrogen | H2I-003/004 | Inlet/outlet basis and product class supplied | User input; range unresolved |
| Hydrogen pipeline product class | discrete record | Hydrogen | H2I-004 | Qualified diameter, pressure and length envelope | User input; product set unresolved |

Missing ranges remain explicit because the component evidence does not yet
support a canonical allowed set. COR-01B does not invent defaults.

## Shared Fixed Parameters

| Parameter | Value | Unit | Owner and status |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Real WACC, $r$ | 6.6% | 1/year | METH-003; provisional unsupported assumption |
| Project life, $n$ | 25 | year | METH-003; modelling assumption |
| Hydrogen HHV | 39.4 | kWh/kg | METH-006; sourced and rounded |
| HVDC reference-link rating | 2 | GW/link | ELEC-003/004; sourced fixed parameter [@tennet2024TwoGWProgram; @tennet2025TwoGWStandard] |
| Decommissioning factor | 0.80 | fraction of offshore installation CAPEX | METH-003; modelling assumption |

The 2 GW HVDC rating is not an optimization variable. The electrical component
pages own the ceiling-based link count, partial final-link utilization,
curtailment and feasibility treatment; see
[HVDC Export Cables](../electrical_infra/hvdc_export_cables.qmd) and
[Onshore Grid Connection](../electrical_infra/onshore_grid_connection.qmd).

All other component parameters remain on their owning pages and must expose
value, unit, source or assumption class, applicability and missing-input
behavior.

## Derived Quantities

The deterministic workflow derives, where the owning component is
parameterized:

- installed wind rated capacity;
- turbine coordinates and farm area;
- wake-adjusted production;
- cable, pipeline and platform inventories;
- equipment counts and discrete link or pipeline counts;
- conversion losses and auxiliary demand;
- pre-availability and delivered annual energy;
- initial CAPEX, replacement, decommissioning and annual OPEX; and
- annualized carrier-specific cost.

## Required Outputs

Every case returns:

| Output | Unit/status |
|---|---|
| Calculation status | feasible, infeasible or not_parameterized |
| Status reasons | list of failed constraints or missing owners/inputs |
| Installed wind rated capacity | kW |
| Delivered electricity | MWh-electricity/year, when applicable |
| Landed hydrogen | kg-H2/year and MWh-H2-HHV/year, when applicable |
| Initial installed CAPEX | EUR~2025~ and EUR~2025~/kW-wind |
| Lifecycle capital basis | EUR~2025~ and EUR~2025~/kW-wind |
| Annual OPEX | EUR~2025~/year |
| Annualized modelled cost | EUR~2025~/year |
| Electricity carrier cost | EUR~2025~/MWh-electricity |
| Hydrogen carrier cost | EUR~2025~/MWh-H2-HHV and EUR~2025~/kg-H2 |
| Intermediate ledgers | physical, energy, availability and cost records |

A complete carrier-cost output is reported only for a feasible, fully
parameterized case.
